input.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, urllib.request, os
css=open('/tmp/fonts.css').read()
# split blocks, only latin with U+0000-00FF
blocks=re.findall(r'/\* ([^*]+) \*/\s*(@font-face \{[^}]+\})', css)
seen={}
for label, block in blocks:
    if label.strip()!='latin': continue
    fam=re.search(r"font-family: '([^']+)'",block).group(1)
    style=re.search(r'font-style: (\w+)',block).group(1)
    weight=re.search(r'font-weight: (\d+)',block).group(1)
    url=re.search(r'url\(([^)]+)\)',block).group(1)
    key=(fam,style,weight)
    if key in seen: continue
    fn=f"{fam.replace(' ','')}-{weight}{'i' if style=='italic' else ''}.woff2"
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, 'assets/fonts/'+fn)
    seen[key]=fn
    print(fn)
print(len(seen))
PY

- Build a complete, playable Olympic-themed game with strong graphics, from an empty repo, and verify it with screenshots.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Olympic-themed browser game with strong graphics, self-verify with screenshots, and expand it with more sports plus a button to switch to winter sports. Also make controls tablet-friendly. "Think faster" — aim for efficient iteration.

## Requirements
- User: “Make olympic game but good graphics”
- Build complete playable game; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for self-checks (viewport ≤1280px wide) and only read the latest.
- Support desktop and mobile/touch, with explicit requirement to make tablet controls good.
- User: “Make more sports and think faster and add a bottun to change to winter sports” — add additional sports and a Summer/Winter mode switch button.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/JS canvas 2D game (`OLYMPIA — Track & Field`), no framework/build step.
- Summer trackside championship: 100m sprint, long jump, javelin; 8-athlete field, points 8–1 per event, final podium.
- Night stadium broadcast direction with local WOFF2 fonts, no external runtime dependencies.
- Tablet controls implemented as a dedicated coarse-pointer layout: sprint L/R thumb pads at bottom corners, displacement meter above-left, field-event action button bottom-right, javelin dial bottom-right with release button beside it, prompts raised above controls.
- Javelin rebalanced to be more forgiving/rewarding; javelin flight renderer fixed and athlete scaled with camera zoom.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and all JS modules; bundled 12 local WOFF2 fonts.
- Implemented procedural athlete renderer, stadium world, state machine, three events, audio, HUD UI, scoring/results, ceremony, practice, and localStorage persistence.
- Fixed earlier issues: SprintEvent finish deadlock (`state='finished'` removed), `fireGun()` now shows GO and hides countdown, javelin athlete uses `throwerX`, ceremony camera preserved in `paintWorld`, removed `soundBtn` stopPropagation, `sound.init()` in `onKey`, javelin overhead run anchor added.
- Fixed sprint player continuing past 100m and the finish-timeout condition.
- Fixed `world.sx()` double-anchor bug to `(worldX - camX) * meter`.
- Raised game dt clamp from 0.05 to 0.1 to reduce slow-motion at low FPS.
- Major visual upgrade: bright moon/stars, brighter crowd, stadium fascia LED text, supporter flags, richer track sheen/lane numbers/start glow, better start blocks, sponsor boards moved below ribbon, more visible floodlight beams.
- Fixed jumbotron to read `top/big/sub/value` as well as `board*` keys.
- Fixed javelin crash: `TypeError: Failed to execute 'createLinearGradient' ... non-finite` from undefined `this.u` in `drawSpearFlight`.
- Javelin tuning: angle amplitude 16, softer angle scoring, result `62 + 31*releaseScore*angleScore*(0.8+0.2*speedFactor) + precision`, auto-throw ×0.9; flight camera zooms and athlete scales down.
- Added `is-touch`/`is-tablet` body classes (`?touch=1` override supported), touch-aware prompt keys (L/R/TAP), touch action labels, and full tablet CSS control layout.
- Verified sprint completion (9.78s), long-jump completion (8.85m), menu/results visuals, and console otherwise clean except favicon 404.

### Active
- The newest user request (more sports + summer/winter toggle) is not started.
- Tablet layout CSS was just added but not yet visually verified at a tablet viewport/touch device.
- Javelin retune and crash fix not yet re-tested in browser after edits.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload and verify tablet layout at ~1024×768 with touch emulation (`playwright-cli open --device ...` or `?touch=1`); inspect sprint, long jump, and javelin HUD control positions for overlap.
2. Re-test javelin practice end-to-end after the crash/scoring changes; confirm no console errors and a competitive result.
3. Add additional summer sports (e.g., hurdles/high jump/shot put) using the existing event framework and scoring.
4. Add a prominent Summer/Winter toggle button and a winter-sports mode with at least 2–3 winter events; persist or reset series appropriately.
5. Capture 1280px-wide JPEG screenshots of menu, tablet controls, each new sport, and ceremony; fix layout/graphics issues.
6. Playtest full series and winter series to ceremony; confirm no errors.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: game loop, state machine, UI, scoring, ceremony, touch detection, particles, bindings.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/events.js`: SprintEvent, LongJumpEvent, JavelinEvent mechanics/rendering; new sports go here.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: stadium/environment/crowd/track/podium rendering; visual upgrades.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full UI system; new tablet layout near end of file; mobile queries.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM/UI structure, screens, HUD, dial.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/athlete.js`: procedural athlete poses/kits and javelin prop.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio crowd/gun/steps/cheers/fanfare.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/utils.js`: math/format/color helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: static server launcher honoring `PORT`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: verification captures (latest: `javelin-flight.jpeg`, `javelin-end.jpeg`, `menu3.jpeg`, `race3.jpeg`, `results-sprint.jpeg`).

## Important Context
- Working directory: `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`; repo initially only had runtime metadata; all work is uncommitted.
- Server running in tmux session `olympia` at `http://localhost:3002` via `PORT=3002 ./start.sh`.
- Playwright browser expected `chromium-1243`; symlinked `~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243` → `chromium-1254` to make `playwright-cli` work.
- Screenshots must use absolute `--filename=.../screenshots/name.jpeg --type jpeg`; relative filenames have silently failed.
- Software rendering runs ~7–16 FPS at 960×620; screenshots can take several seconds and may time out on first attempt — retry.
- `window.__olympia` exposes the Game instance.
- Javelin autopilot note: tapping requires both `x` near 36 and angle near 36; narrow timing window unless using the retuned scoring.
- Predicted balance: sprint ~9.78s with ~11 taps/s; long jump ~8.4–8.9m; javelin now ~75–93m depending on angle/release alignment. AI bests: sprint 9.79, long jump 8.44m, javelin 90.6m.
- Avatar/athlete rendering is procedural vector art; screenshots show stylized side-view athletes with lane overlap at starts (accepted style).

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished Olympic-themed browser game with strong graphics, self-verify with screenshots, expand it with more sports, add a Summer/Winter mode switch button, and keep controls tablet-friendly. User also said “Think faster” twice, emphasizing rapid iteration.

## Requirements
- “Make olympic game but good graphics”
- Build a complete playable game; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for self-checks (viewport ≤1280px wide) and only read the latest.
- Support desktop and mobile/touch, with explicit requirement to make tablet controls good.
- “Make more sports and think faster and add a bottun to change to winter sports”
- “Think faster”

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/JS canvas 2D game (`OLYMPIA — Track & Field`), no framework/build step.
- Summer now has 5 events: 100M Sprint, Long Jump, Javelin, 100M Hurdles, Shot Put.
- Winter now has 3 events: Ski Jump, Snowboard X, Curling.
- Reuse mechanics: Hurdles and Snowboard X reuse `SprintEvent`; Shot Put reuses `JavelinEvent`; Ski Jump is new dedicated `SkiJumpEvent`; Curling is new precision `CurlingEvent`.
- Curling is measured in centimetres, lower-is-better; sprint/hurdles/snowboard are time, lower-is-better; distance events higher-is-better.
- Menu programme/practice lists generated dynamically from season event lists; a prominent `.season-toggle` button switches seasons and persists to localStorage (`olympia-season`).
- Winter theme changes UI accent to icy blue via `body.season-winter` CSS variable overrides and world rendering via `world.season`.
- Screenshots must use absolute `--filename=.../screenshots/name.jpeg --type jpeg`; relative filenames silently fail.

## Work State
### Completed
- Earlier game build: procedural athlete/stadium rendering, 3 original events, audio, HUD, scoring, results, ceremony, practice, persistence, tablet touch layout, visual upgrades, javelin crash fix.
- Added EVENTS metadata for 8 total events with season, format, lower-is-better, HUD type, glyph/blurb; added AI attributes for all events.
- Added season-aware game flow: `season`, `seasonEvents()`, `toggleSeason()`, `updateSeasonUi()`, `refreshEventLists()`, season persistence, dynamic campaign facts/ticker/intro numbering.
- Updated `makeEvent()` for hurdles, snowboard, shotput, skijump, curling.
- Generalized sprint events with `id`, `raceDistance`, `distanceScale`, hurdles, board/spray options; added hurdle rendering/collision penalties and winter spray particles.
- Generalized javelin into shot put variant (`optAngle`, `angleAmp`, result base/span/max, `isShot`), added shot-put projectile rendering and measurement.
- Added `SkiJumpEvent` and `CurlingEvent` classes.
- Added season toggle button HTML/CSS, dynamic programme/practice containers, winter UI accent.
- Started world winter theming: added `season`, new layout modes (`skijump`, `curling`), winter sky palette/haze.
- Main still renders; no syntax verification yet after latest edits.

### Active
- Finish winter world rendering: mountains/aurora, snow/ice ground and tracks, ski hill, curling house/rings, winter snowfall, seasonal banners/ribbons.
- Add athlete `skis` and `board` prop support in `athlete.js`; `events.js` already passes these options.
- Verify and fix syntax/runtime errors from new event classes and generalized code.
- Update guide modal for new summer/winter events (currently still 3 summer events).
- Verify tablet layout and all new events with screenshots; test full summer and winter series to ceremony.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish `src/world.js` winter rendering: `drawCity` mountains/aurora, `drawGround` snow/ice, `drawSprintTrack` winter ice, `drawRunway` snow, `drawSkiJumpHill`, `drawCurlingSheet`, `drawAtmosphere` snowfall, seasonal fascia/LED/jumbotron text.
2. Add `skis` and `board` options to `drawAthlete` in `src/athlete.js`.
3. Run `node --check` on JS modules and load the game; fix errors, especially generalized sprint/javelin and new curling/ski jump flows.
4. Test each event via `window.__olympia` or UI, both seasons; ensure results units/sorting/ceremony are correct.
5. Capture 1280px JPEG screenshots of summer menu, winter menu/toggle, hurdles, shot put, ski jump, snowboard, curling, tablet controls, and ceremony; inspect latest only.
6. Update guide copy and any mobile/tablet CSS regressions for 5 summer events and curling HUD.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: EVENTS metadata, season state/toggle, dynamic menus, event flow, scoring/units, HUD, ceremony.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/events.js`: generalized SprintEvent/JavelinEvent plus SkiJumpEvent and CurlingEvent.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: stadium/world rendering; winter theming incomplete.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/athlete.js`: procedural athlete; needs `skis`/`board` props.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: new season toggle/winter accent CSS; tablet/mobile layouts.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: added season toggle, dynamic programme/practice containers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural sound API (`tone`, `noise`, `whoosh`, `jump`, `sand`, `cheer`, etc.).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/utils.js`: math/format helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: static server honoring `PORT`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: verification captures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full UI system and responsive/touch rules.

## Important Context
- Working directory: `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`; all work remains uncommitted.
- Server runs in tmux session `olympia` at `http://localhost:3002` via `PORT=3002 ./start.sh`.
- Playwright expects `chromium-1243`; `~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243` is symlinked to `chromium-1254`.
- `window.__olympia` exposes the Game instance.
- Software rendering ~7–16 FPS at 960×620; screenshots may take seconds and time out on first attempt — retry.
- `BaseEvent.paint()` still calls `game.paintWorld(this.id, ...)`; `Game.paintWorld` now uses `currentEvent.worldMode` for camera/world mode and sets `world.season`.
- Curling target/house is at world x `27.5`; stone release starts at x `3.2`; result = |stone stop − 27.5| × 100 cm.
- Ski jump takeoff lip at world x `40.5`, result ~78–143 m, camera zooms out during flight.
- AI best values include: sprint 9.79, long jump 8.44m, javelin 90.6m, hurdles 12.25s, shot put 23.4m, ski jump 139.2m, snowboard 9.98s, curling 28cm (lower better).
- HUD action button is shown for all non-sprint events; javelin dial only for `javelin` (not shot put).
- Dynamic lists rely on `#programmeList`, `#practiceGrid`, `#seasonLabel`, `#seasonAlt`, `.campaign-facts`, `.ticker-track`.
- `body.season-winter` changes `--gold`/`--gold-2`/`--gold-3` to icy blue, affecting all gold UI accents.
- Potential runtime issue: `drawAthlete` ignores `skis`/`board` until athlete.js is updated; no crash expected.
- Potential syntax issue: new event code added after final class in `events.js`; verify with `node --check src/events.js`.
